gui.fornax.settings.title: Fornax
gui.fornax.packs.header.label: Shaders
gui.fornax.packs.header.tooltip: Master switch -- when off, Fornax renders pure vanilla Sodium with no pack graph. Staged; applies on Apply.
gui.fornax.packs.none.tooltip: No shaderpack: pure vanilla Sodium rendering.
gui.fornax.packs.pack_settings.tooltip: Options for the active pack. Enabled only once the selected pack is the loaded one.
gui.fornax.packs.apply.tooltip: Commit the staged shaders toggle and pack selection.
gui.fornax.manage.import.tooltip: Load settings from a file you choose and apply them. Unknown options are skipped.
gui.fornax.manage.export.tooltip: Save the pack's current settings to a file you choose.
gui.fornax.manage.reset.tooltip: Reset every option on every page to the pack's defaults, then apply immediately.
gui.fornax.manage.reset.title: Reset all options?
gui.fornax.manage.reset.body: This resets every option on every page to the pack's defaults and applies immediately.
gui.fornax.manage.shader_options.tooltip: Open the pack's shader option pages.
gui.fornax.option.aa_method.tooltip: Click to cycle. Off: no anti-aliasing. TAA: temporal AA at native resolution. SSAA: render above native and downsample (sharpest, heaviest; factor below). TAAU: render below native and temporally upscale (biggest performance win; ratio below). MetalFX: render below native and upscale with Apple's ML temporal scaler (Apple silicon only; uses the TAAU ratio below).
gui.fornax.option.ssaa_preset.tooltip: Supersampling factor, applied while Anti-aliasing / Upscaling is set to SSAA. Higher factors cost VRAM and GPU time quickly.
gui.fornax.option.taau_ratio.tooltip: Click to cycle. Quality: 75% render scale. Balanced: 66%. Performance: 50% (fastest, softest).
gui.fornax.option.frame_generation.toolt: Experimental. Interpolates one generated frame between each pair of real frames using Apple's MetalFX frame interpolator. Requires vsync (FIFO present mode) and adds about 1 frame of latency.
gui.fornax.option.profiler_overlay.toolt: Shows a per-pass GPU timing panel in the top-left corner, graded against the 11.1 ms / 90 FPS budget.
gui.fornax.option.debug_view.tooltip: Click to cycle (F9 in-game). Off, then the G-buffer channels: Normals, Albedo, Material, AO, Motion, Depth, plus pipeline views (SSAO, shadows, sky, emitters...). For diagnosing rendering issues.
gui.fornax.option.metal_hud.tooltip: macOS only. Shows Apple's built-in Metal Performance HUD overlay (GPU frame time, present rate). Takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
gui.fornax.option.voxel_reach_ignores_re: Off (default): colored light reach is capped by your render distance, so voxel-window VRAM/compute never exceeds what's already loaded. On: honors the pack's Colored Light Reach setting up to the engine's own cap (192 blocks) regardless of render distance -- costs more VRAM/compute, including in directions terrain isn't even rendering. Does not affect the separate, smaller cap Light Detail: High applies.
gui.fornax.option.sun_path_rotation.tool:
How far the sun and moon's daily arc leans away from straight overhead.

Vanilla's path passes exactly through the zenith, so at noon the sun is directly above you, shadows collapse underneath whatever casts them, and midday has no direction. Tilting keeps the sun off the zenith: at -25 degrees it tops out around 65 degrees instead of 90. This is the same control shaderpacks expose as sunPathRotation, where -40 is a common choice.

0 is vanilla. Applies to the shadow map, the pack's lighting and the visible sun and moon together, since all three are built from one direction.
gui.fornax.option.sidecar_map_resolution: How much of a resource pack's authored labPBR normal (_n) and specular (_s) map resolution to keep. Full uses what the pack shipped and costs the most VRAM by far — around 1.4 GB per atlas on a 512x pack. Half is the default and is what previous builds produced on large packs. Changing this reloads resources.
